definition: A technique for improving retrieval by automatically generating additional or reformulated search queries related to the original query.
details: Query expansion can help retrieval systems find relevant documents that use different terminology than the original query, improving recall in both keyword-based and embedding-based search.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. And that is Query Expansion — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
